meta.title: 2026-cycle FBS-to-FBS transfer compilation
meta.scope: Players who entered the portal in the 2025-26 winter window (Jan 2-16, 2026, plus championship extra window) and announced or completed an FBS destination, plus publicly reported graduate and summer/fall 2026 FBS-to-FBS completions.
meta.exclusion: FCS, D2, D3, NAIA, JUCO, and high-school origins excluded. Destinations never inferred; available/unsigned portal players omitted unless a destination was announced.
meta.completeness: NOT a full census. On3 listed 2,844 committed of 3,723 in-portal football players; The Athletic counted ~2,556 signed FBS scholarship transfers. This file is a verified working subset emphasizing Power 4 incoming classes plus selected Group of 5 and late-cycle adds, cross-checked against USA TODAY conference trackers, On3, 247Sports, and The Athletic.
meta.schema: player, position, class_raw, from_team_slug, to_team_slug, status, event_date, snaps_prior_season, notes, sources, confidence
